description:
Get gross domestic product for U.S. states from BEA Regional dataset.

Table options:
- SAGDP1: State annual GDP summary (default)
- SAGDP9: Real GDP by state
- SQGDP1: State quarterly GDP summary

GeoFips: 'STATE' for all states, or 5-digit FIPS (e.g. '06000' for CA)

geo_fips.description: Geography: 'STATE' (all states, default), or state FIPS + '000' (e.g. '06000' for CA, '48000' for TX)

table_name.description: Regional table: 'SAGDP1' (annual GDP summary, default), 'SAGDP9' (real GDP), 'SQGDP1' (quarterly GDP summary)

name: bea_gdp_by_state
